notes: A prefab is a pose. pose goes into {{pose}} (no trailing period) and may use any placeholder; a pose that is only a variable ({{idlePose}}) opens a 'Variação da pose' field.
defaults apply when the prefab is picked, except for locked fields. Leave character fields out so the character carries over between poses.

prefabs.name: Patinha tímida
prefabs.desc: Mão em patinha no queixo, a outra puxando o casaco.
prefabs.pose: shoulders slightly turned, one sleeve-covered hand curled into a cat-paw gesture under her chin, the other hand lightly tugging the edge of her top, head tilted to the side

prefabs.name: Idle (parada, em pé)
prefabs.desc: Em pé e relaxada; escolha a variação no campo Pose.
prefabs.pose: {{idlePose}}

prefabs.name: Cachecol ao vento
prefabs.desc: Segura o cachecol junto ao rosto, ponta voando.
prefabs.pose: standing in three-quarter view, both hands holding a long, chunky knitted scarf up near her cheeks, one end of the scarf blowing in the wind to the side, weight on one leg, head tilted slightly

prefabs.name: Olhar por cima do ombro
prefabs.desc: De costas, vira só a cabeça para trás.
prefabs.pose: body turned away from the viewer, looking back over her shoulder, both hands loosely clasped behind her back, tail curling to the side

prefabs.name: Espreguiçando
prefabs.desc: Braços para cima como um gato acordando.
prefabs.pose: stretching both arms up over her head like a cat waking up, fingers interlaced, one eye squeezed shut, tail standing straight up

prefabs.name: Acenando
prefabs.desc: Dá tchau com uma mão levantada.
prefabs.pose: waving at the viewer with one hand raised beside her face, the other hand holding the strap of a small shoulder bag, ears perked up

prefabs.name: Sinal de paz
prefabs.desc: V da vitória perto do olho, cabeça inclinada.
prefabs.pose: making a peace sign next to one eye, leaning her head toward it, the other hand resting on her hip

prefabs.name: Nya! (duas patinhas)
prefabs.desc: As duas mãos em patinha ao lado do rosto.
prefabs.pose: both hands curled into cat paws and raised beside her face in a playful "nya" pose, shoulders slightly raised, tail curled into a question mark

prefabs.name: Ajeitando o cabelo
prefabs.desc: Coloca uma mecha atrás da orelha de gato.
prefabs.pose: tucking a strand of hair behind one of her cat ears with one hand, the other arm relaxed at her side, head slightly lowered

prefabs.name: Caneca quentinha
prefabs.desc: Segura uma caneca de chocolate quente com as duas mãos.
prefabs.pose: holding a warm mug of hot cocoa with both hands close to her chin, soft steam rising from it, sleeves covering half of her hands

prefabs.name: Abraçando pelúcia
prefabs.desc: Abraça um gato de pelúcia grande.
prefabs.pose: hugging a large, soft cat plushie against her chest with both arms, chin resting on the plushie's head

prefabs.name: Guarda-chuva
prefabs.desc: Guarda-chuva transparente no ombro, olhando a chuva.
prefabs.pose: holding a clear umbrella over her shoulder with both hands, raindrops on the umbrella, ears slightly flattened by the rain sound

prefabs.name: Livro no peito
prefabs.desc: Abraça um livro aberto e espia por cima dele.
prefabs.pose: holding an open book against her lower face with both hands, peeking over its top edge, ears perked up

prefabs.name: Rosto na mão (tédio)
prefabs.desc: Sentada no chão, joelho dobrado, apoiando o rosto.
prefabs.pose: sitting on the floor with one knee raised, leaning back on one hand, resting her cheek on her other hand, head tilted, tail lying lazily on the floor

prefabs.name: Abraçando os joelhos
prefabs.desc: Encolhida abraçando os joelhos, queixo apoiado.
prefabs.pose: sitting on the floor hugging her knees close to her chest, chin resting on her knees, tail wrapped around her feet

prefabs.name: Sentada de lado
prefabs.desc: Pernas dobradas para um lado, mãos no colo.
prefabs.pose: sitting gracefully on the floor with her legs folded to one side, hands resting in her lap, back straight, tail curled beside her

prefabs.name: Deitada de bruços
prefabs.desc: Deitada, apoiada nos cotovelos, queixo nas mãos.
prefabs.pose: lying on her stomach on a soft rug, propped up on her elbows with her chin resting on her hands, her tail swaying behind her

prefabs.name: Soneca de gato
prefabs.desc: Dormindo enrolada como um gato.
prefabs.pose: curled up asleep on her side like a cat on a soft blanket, hands tucked near her face, tail wrapped around her body

prefabs.name: Na janela
prefabs.desc: Sentada no parapeito, olhando a chuva lá fora.
prefabs.pose: sitting on a wide windowsill with one knee up, arms resting on that knee, gazing out of the window, tail hanging down over the edge

prefabs.name: Dentro da caixa
prefabs.desc: Enfiada numa caixa de papelão pequena demais.
prefabs.pose: sitting inside a cardboard box that is clearly too small for her, only her head, shoulders and paw-like hands peeking over the edge, ears perked up, tail sticking out of one side

prefabs.name: Retrato close
prefabs.desc: Cabeça e ombros, mão tocando a bochecha.
prefabs.pose: head and shoulders, body turned slightly, head tilted, one hand lightly touching her cheek

prefabs.name: Espiando da borda
prefabs.desc: Aparece só metade, espiando da beirada do quadro.
prefabs.pose: peeking in from the right edge of the frame as if hiding behind it: only her head, one shoulder, one hand gripping the edge and one cat ear are visible

prefabs.name: Bocejo
prefabs.desc: Bocejando com a manga na boca, esfregando o olho.
prefabs.pose: yawning while covering her mouth with a sleeve-covered hand, the other hand rubbing one eye, ears drooping slightly

prefabs.name: Selfie
prefabs.desc: Tirando selfie com sinal de paz.
prefabs.pose: taking a selfie, one arm extended toward the camera holding a phone, the other hand making a peace sign, cheek tilted toward the phone

prefabs.name: Abraçada no travesseiro
prefabs.desc: Rosto meio escondido num travesseiro.
prefabs.pose: hugging a big pillow with both arms, the lower half of her face hidden behind it, only her eyes and ears peeking over

prefabs.name: Pulinho feliz
prefabs.desc: Pulando no lugar, cabelo e cauda voando.
prefabs.pose: jumping happily in place with both feet off the ground, arms raised in joy, hair and tail flowing upward

prefabs.name: Novelo de lã
prefabs.desc: Ajoelhada brincando com um novelo.
prefabs.pose: kneeling on the floor and batting playfully at a ball of {{accentColor}} yarn with one paw-like hand, the yarn unraveling around her, tail raised, ears perked

prefabs.name: Pegando neve
prefabs.desc: Estica a mão para os flocos de neve caindo.
prefabs.pose: reaching one hand up toward softly falling snowflakes, the other hand holding the end of her scarf, breath visible in the cold air

prefabs.name: Girando
prefabs.desc: Rodopiando, roupa e cabelo em movimento.
prefabs.pose: twirling in place with her arms slightly out, her clothes, hair and tail swirling with the motion

prefabs.name: Feitiço
prefabs.desc: Bruxinha lançando um feitiço com brilhos.
prefabs.pose: casting a little spell with one hand raised, small sparkles and stars swirling around her fingers, her cape fluttering, the other hand holding the brim of her hat

prefabs.name: Na carteira
prefabs.desc: Sentada na carteira, queixo na mão, lápis no caderno.
prefabs.pose: sitting at a school desk, chin resting on one hand, the other hand holding a pencil over an open notebook

prefabs.name: Dedo na bochecha
prefabs.desc: Pensando numa pergunta, dedo na bochecha.
prefabs.pose: one index finger pressed thoughtfully to her cheek, the other hand holding a pencil, head tilted as if thinking about a hard question

prefabs.name: Levantando a mão
prefabs.desc: Mão para cima, sabe a resposta.
prefabs.pose: sitting up straight at her desk, raising one hand high as if she knows the answer, the other hand resting on her notebook

prefabs.name: Janela da sala
prefabs.desc: Na janela da sala, olhando para trás, cortina ao vento.
prefabs.pose: standing by the classroom window with one hand resting on the window frame, looking back over her shoulder at the viewer, the curtain drifting in the breeze

prefabs.name: Chegando no portão
prefabs.desc: Bolsa na mão, acenando no portão com cerejeiras.
prefabs.pose: standing at the school gate, her school bag held in one hand in front of her, the other hand raised in a small wave

prefabs.name: Corredor com livros
prefabs.desc: Andando no corredor com livros, olha para você.
prefabs.pose: walking down the hallway carrying a few books in both arms, glancing sideways at the viewer mid-step, tail swaying behind her

prefabs.name: Lanche no terraço
prefabs.desc: Bentô no colo no terraço, hashi na mão.
prefabs.pose: sitting on the school rooftop with a bento box on her lap, holding chopsticks with a bite of food halfway to her mouth

prefabs.name: No quadro-negro
prefabs.desc: Pega no flagra escrevendo no quadro.
prefabs.pose: standing at the blackboard holding a piece of chalk, half turned toward the viewer as if caught mid-sentence, the board covered in simple doodles with no readable text

prefabs.name: Mascote de desktop
prefabs.desc: Corpo inteiro e fundo transparente; escolha a variação no campo Pose.
prefabs.pose: {{mascotPose}}

prefabs.name: Café à janela
prefabs.desc: Sentada no café, xícara nas mãos, chuva lá fora.
prefabs.pose: sitting at a small café table by the window, both hands around a warm cup, looking out at the rainy street

prefabs.name: Telhado ao pôr do sol
prefabs.desc: Sentada na beira do telhado olhando a cidade.
prefabs.pose: sitting on a rooftop ledge with her legs hanging over the edge, hands on the ledge beside her, tail curled around one arm, looking at the city

prefabs.name: Biblioteca
prefabs.desc: Na ponta dos pés pegando um livro alto.
prefabs.pose: standing on tiptoe between tall bookshelves, reaching up to pull a book from a high shelf, tail raised for balance

prefabs.name: Noite de neve
prefabs.desc: Na rua com neve, segurando o cachecol.
prefabs.pose: standing on a snowy street, both hands holding her scarf up to her cheeks, snowflakes on her hair and ears

prefabs.name: Cerejeiras
prefabs.desc: Pétalas caindo, ela tenta pegar uma.
prefabs.pose: standing under cherry blossom trees, one hand reaching out to catch a falling petal, the breeze moving her hair
